name: Oklahoma Comic Con
blurb: Tulsa, Oklahoma comic convention at the Arvest Convention Center with celebrity, creator and cosplay guests.
notes: The official site (run by VXV Events, LLC) shows no date text anywhere on the homepage or the guests page as of 2026-10-05.
